subject: math

objective.text: Relate doubles to even numbers, and write number sentences to express the sums.

explanations.title: Doubles
explanations.text: A doubles fact has two addends that are the same. 3 plus 3 equals 6 is a doubles fact.

explanations.title: Pattern in doubles
explanations.text: 1 plus 1, 2 plus 2, 3 plus 3 and so on. Each addend goes up by 1. The total goes up by 2. It is like counting by twos.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (S: Each addend goes up by 1, so the answer goes up by 2)

explanations.title: Even numbers
explanations.text: Even numbers are the totals of doubles. Two people share fairly and each has the same. Skip-counting by twos gives even numbers.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (S: Even numbers mean it's the same number)

explanations.title: Say it as doubled
explanations.text: 5 doubled is 10. 3 doubled is 6. Doubling a number gives an even number.

explanations.title: Subtraction pattern
explanations.text: Add 10 to the whole and subtract the same number. 11 minus 9 is 2. 21 minus 9 is 12. 31 minus 9 is 22.

examples.title: Fingers doubles
examples.text: Thumbs up: 1 plus 1 equals 2. Index fingers up too: 2 plus 2 equals 4. Keep going to 5 plus 5 equals 10.

examples.title: Counter doubles
examples.text: 6 plus 6 equals 12. 7 plus 7 equals 14. 8 plus 8 equals 16. All the totals are even.
